faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) post at IISER Pune?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) position at IISER Pune is 11 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University or Institute. Additionally, 5 years of relevant experience is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for direct recruitment is 40 years. For deputation, the maximum age limit is 56 years. Age relaxations are applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) position?
faq.answer: The position is offered at Pay Level 10, with an entry pay of ₹ 56,100/-. The total monthly emoluments are approximately ₹ 1,18,100/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) post at IISER Pune.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online. Candidates need to apply through the official IISER Pune website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a Written Test and/or any other evaluation process, followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Pune (IISER Pune), in Pune, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the link to apply online in the "Important Links" section of this article. Please ensure you visit the official IISER Pune website for the application.
